title: OgreBattleBootConfig
description: Configuration schema for Ogre Battle Area 4 Boot-Time Decoupling Pipeline

description.description: Description of the boot configuration and mod selections

memory_size.description: Target ROM buffer size. 'auto' selects 2.0MB if any active feature/preset requires it.

overlays.description: Ordered list of file paths to JSON mod manifests to apply sequentially

magic_ai_elemental_fix.description: Fix enemy magic user AI to test target's equipped item elemental resistance

prevent_random_crown_drops.description: Remove Crowns from random map drops and reroll rare undead relics

extensible_size_tables.description: Decouple hardcoded bitwise size math to read extensible size table in Bank 30

recalculate_checksum.description: Recalculate and update SNES internal checksum and complement
